meta.titleDrivingGame: Driving game — 3D car racing and drift online — cv.cm
meta.descDrivingGame: Free 3D driving game in your browser: race three laps against the clock or slide through corners in drift mode. Three tracks, keyboard or touch controls, no download.

driving-game.name: Driving game
driving-game.blurb: Race a 3D car round three tracks, or drift for points.

driving-game.a1: Arrow keys or W A S D: up accelerates, down brakes and then reverses, left and right steer. Space is the handbrake and R puts you back at the last checkpoint.
driving-game.a2: Points build up while the car slides more than 15 degrees sideways at speed; faster and wider slides score more. A slide is banked when you straighten up. Hitting the tyre wall or staying on the grass for over a second loses the slide in progress. A drift run lasts 60 seconds.
driving-game.q3: Can I play on a phone?
driving-game.a3: Yes. Steering buttons sit bottom left, and brake, handbrake and accelerator bottom right. Turn the phone sideways and use full screen for the biggest view.
driving-game.q4: Which tracks are there, and are my times saved?
driving-game.a4: There are three fixed circuits, so a lap time is comparable every time. Your best lap and best drift score on each track are kept in this browser only.
driving-game.q5: Why is it slow or blank on my device?
driving-game.a5: The game needs WebGL. On phones it draws at a lower resolution and without shadows; closing other tabs helps. If the 3D view stops, press Start again.

driving-game.lead: Drive a 3D car in three steps.
driving-game.s1b: Choose one of three tracks, then Time trial (three laps) or Drift (60 seconds), and press Play.
driving-game.s2b: Wait for the 3-2-1, then accelerate with up or W and steer with the arrows. On a phone, use the buttons on the screen.
driving-game.s3b: Pass every checkpoint to count a lap. Your best lap and best drift score on each track are saved.
